name: POND
author: Charles Vestal
tagline: A generative garden pond for the FM-1
description: POND turns the M-VAVE FM-1 into a generative garden pond, derived from AMB-1. It plays itself from the moment it is switched on: breathing voices, water drops on loops of unequal length, a gliding bass and quiet drips, through a tape echo and a plate reverb. It has eight pieces. You don't perform it, you tend it: pick a piece and a scale, take notes out, put them back, and let the pond grow.
credits: Derived from AMB-1 by Charles Vestal. Built on fm1-base and felucca-bsp, from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments).
